module.purpose: Defines the authenticated tRPC organization router, connecting organization, team, member, administration, and phone-call operations to their dedicated handlers with validated inputs and authorization policies.
module.summary: This file is the organization-facing API composition layer for the viewer tRPC namespace. It registers query and mutation procedures, applies Zod input schemas where required, enforces authenticated, organization-admin, administrator, or event-owner access, and lazily imports handler implementations. The router centralizes organization lifecycle, membership, team, user, administration, verification, and phone-call capabilities without embedding business logic.
module.businessContext: This router supports organization management in a scheduling platform, including teams, members, users, branding, and onboarding. Failure prevents customers and administrators from managing organizational scheduling operations.
